# Glencoe Heating & Cooling

> Glencoe Heating & Cooling is a local HVAC company serving Glencoe, Middlesex County, Ontario, offering furnace repair, AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump repair and installation, fireplace installation, thermostat repair, and duct cleaning to homeowners across the region.

Phone: (519) 287-0144  |  Email: contact@glencoeheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://glencoeheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Glencoe, Newbury, Mount Brydges, Wardsville, Melbourne, Appin
